resolve_model_overlay: resolve the model overlay spec for a given model name or path from the overlay registry
resolve_model_overlay_target: resolve the overlay target returning source model id and overlay spec for a model name or path
materialize_overlay_model: materialize an overlay model by combining source weights with overlay metadata into a final directory
download_overlay_metadata: download overlay metadata from a bundled dir, local path, or huggingface hub repo
maybe_resolve_overlay_model_path: resolve and materialize an overlay model path from a model name or path with full download support
